findings.title: A validly signed token whose exp is a numeric string or 1e300 is accepted (p.exp > nowSec coerces); sub and role are strictly checked
findings.evidence: be/src/auth.ts verifyToken: `p.exp > nowSec && typeof p.sub === 'number'`. Live (token signed with the server secret): exp:'<future>' and exp:1e300 -> 200 on /me; sub as string/float/negative -> 401.
findings.actual: accepted, but only a holder of AUTH_SECRET can mint such a token; the server itself always issues numeric exp. Role is read from the database, never from the claim (verified: a student sub with role:'teacher' claim gets 403 on teacher routes)
findings.fix_hint: optional: add typeof/isFinite check on exp

findings.area: Authorization header parsing / reserved demo domain
findings.title: 'Bearer  <token>' (two spaces) is accepted; 'x@demo.escape-lab.app.' (trailing dot) is not treated as the reserved demo domain
findings.evidence: Live: Authorization 'Bearer  tok' -> 200 on /me; register x@demo.escape-lab.app. -> 201 while x@demo.escape-lab.app -> 400 reserved_email.
findings.actual: no impact: the trailing-dot address is a different, unique e-mail and cannot reach the seeded demo accounts; with DEMO_MODE off flagged accounts are refused by is_demo_account, not by domain
